statement: There is an absolute integer P such that, for every prime p ≥ P, there are a probability measure µp on FV p and a nonnegative submeasure εp ≤ µp whose mass satisfies ηp = εp(FV p ) ≤ p−4 . Writing µ◦ p = µp − εp 1 − ηp , the following properties hold. 1. The full law µp is reflection positive. Both µp and εp are invariant under simultaneous changes zv 7→ qzv + a, where a ∈ Fp and q ∈ Q∗ p. Every single-label marginal of µp and µ◦ p is uniform on Fp. 2. On the support of µ◦ p, zvj+1 − zvj ∈ Q∗ p (0 ≤ j < h). The marginal of each ordered pair (zvj , zvj+1 ) under µ◦ p is uniform on {(x, y) : y − x ∈ Q∗ p}. 3. Put γ = 1/64.
